newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Henderson Land shares fall after results.
newsitem.headline: Henderson Land shares fall after results.

text.p: Shares of Henderson Land Development Co Ltd eased on profit-taking after the company reported its interim earnings, brokers said on Thursday.

Henderson Land shares fell HK$0.75 to HK$64.00 in late morning after they hit a morning high of HK$65.75. The shares had gained HK$1.75 or 2.78 percent in the last three trading days to close at HK$64.75 on Wednesday.
"The better-than-expected earnings gave investors an excuse to buy in early trade," said Edwin Cheung, senior sales manager from Taiwan Securities.
Brokers said overseas selling emerged after buying orders dried up later.
"We expect the shares to gain support at the current price level, the company's earnings outlook is also seen promising,' said a sales manager at regional brokerage.
Henderson Land beat market expectations for interim earnings growth on Wednesday by posting a 33 percent rise in net profit to HK$5.32 billion for the six months ended December 1996.
